# Surtling trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophySurtling | Source: Surtling | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Surtling trophy is a rare drop from Surtlings found within the Swamp.

### Crafting

• Nimble Anklet

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an item stand, emits a small light in a similar way to a fire torch.
• Can be used to program Balistas.

Categorias: Trophies
